# Seeker method, applicability and independent numerical references

Current-status update, 2026-11-03: the JSON now documents each current model
individually in theory, parameter and fidelity matrices. Its current `passed`
flag is false until a fresh actual native comparison under these source/card
hashes succeeds. Earlier72-row/836-constraint and older818-assertion results
are historical only and remain nested as `historical_evidence`. They do not
verify the new reticle receiver or the current scene-policy epoch. The separate
[72-cell parameterized table](per-model-effects-components.json) retains exact
source records and does not grant native/public/visual or calibration status.


This document describes the executing SDK methods for the **24 authored AAM
cards**, not 24 verified OEM seeker designs. The companion [seeker.json](seeker.json)
contains each original equipment selector, actual mechanism, full resolved
parameter records, provenance, uncertainties, theory delta and numerical
residuals. `equipment.<card>.seeker` establishes selection identity; it is not a
new hardware designation or a calibration result. A family artifact is admitted
only after the actual native observations pass the independent checker.

## Equations and actual mechanisms

The current V3 composition uses four native mechanisms: nonimaging IR, imaging
IR, semi-active radar and active radar. These share the finite gimbal, measurement
queue and track/navigation machinery, but receive through explicit physical
receiver bindings rather than substituting the retained scalar V2/V3 model.

For grey thermal sources, the vacuum spectral radiance is

\[
L_\lambda(T,\epsilon)=\epsilon\frac{2hc^2}{\lambda^5}
 [\exp(hc/(\lambda kT))-1]^{-1},\qquad
L_{band}=\int_{\lambda_l}^{\lambda_h}L_\lambda\,d\lambda .
\]

The primary basis is [NIST SP250-43, section2, equation4, printed page6](https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/Legacy/SP/nistspecialpublication250-43.pdf).
The reference uses the exact h, c and k in the [BIPM SI Brochure, section2.2](https://www.bipm.org/documents/20126/41483022/SI-Brochure-9.pdf).
NIST's historical rounded constants are not misrepresented as current exact SI.
The SDK integrates `x^3/expm1(x)` with composite Simpson quadrature, at least64
even intervals and approximately16 intervals per unit x, with the tail cut at80.
It uses the rounded second radiation constant0.01438776877 m K and the rounded
Stefan constant5.670374419e-8 W/(m² K⁴). Their small numerical differences are
included in the declared comparison budget.

Projected source rectangles are depth ordered and clipped into visible regions.
Gaussian optical blur is integrated over finite detector rectangles; off-detector
flux is lost, not renormalized. Exposure uses the explicitly selected number of
backward scene samples. The effective photon conversion is

\[
Q_{ph}=L_{band}\Omega A\tau t_{int} QE\lambda_{eff}/(hc),\quad
Q_{state}\leftarrow Q_{state}+(1-e^{-\Delta t/\tau_p})(Q_{ph}-Q_{state}).
\]

Dark current adds `Idark*tint`. Actual measured charge then has Poisson shot
noise, Gaussian read noise, finite full well and ADC quantization. The retained compatibility quadrant receiver derives signed contrast errors; the seven currently selected nonimaging AAMs instead use the distinct scalar conical-scan reticle described below. Imaging
receivers estimate background/contrast, segment finite image features and
associate measured feature direction/extent; they do not receive source IDs as
measurement inputs. MICA IR has two independent channel policies and explicit
spectral pairing gates. Its second authored band is included in the radiance
comparison; a common Planck pass does not independently calibrate dual-band
discrimination.

The RF equation is independently derived as transmitter flux, target scattering,
effective receive aperture and thermal noise:

\[
P_r=\frac{P_tG_t}{4\pi R_t^2}\frac{\sigma}{4\pi R_r^2}
       \frac{G_r\lambda^2}{4\pi L},\qquad
SNR=P_rt/(kTF).
\]

This follows [MIT Lincoln Laboratory's Radar Equation course, slides5-10 and13](https://www.ll.mit.edu/media/6946).
The coherent energy representation cancels matched-filter bandwidth; it does
not add a range bonus. Actual aperture gain comes from the authored aperture's
native Fourier pattern. Monostatic propagation uses the same range and excess
loss twice. Bistatic propagation uses separate transmitter/receiver ranges and
losses. SARH additionally requires actual captured illumination, pulse-program
phase/crop and temporal M-of-N PRF coincidence. ARH uses its own transmitter.
The production receiver synthesizes finite range/Doppler cells, noise and
clutter, applies CFAR/gates and temporal association, and produces measurements;
referee attribution is attached after detection.

## State, inputs, outputs and time

Inputs are the authored resolved receiver policies; finite time, boresight and
body axes; navigation estimate at the observation epoch; physical radiance
patches or RF echoes/ground patches; and a release/component RNG stream. Native
World scene formation owns position, altitude, skin/exhaust thermal estimates,
occlusion, atmosphere and actual illumination. Actor knowledge does not become
referee scene truth. The model's permitted launch estimate and later modeled
launcher updates are separate from a live seeker observation.

State includes finite gimbal/search direction and rate/lag; sample cadence and
processing-delay queue; detector temporal charge and RNG; RF illumination
clock/coincidence memory; measured local tracks/association; and navigation
reconstruction. Outputs include observation/sample/receive times, validity,
direction and optional rates/range, measured image features or spectrum cells,
and the selected track. Unknown range remains unavailable. A detector sample is
not an automatic homing lock. Equal-time rereads are cached; time reversal,
malformed policy/scene or absent required navigation is refused. Reset/retarget
semantics are those of the actual release provider and World; this document
does not grant an additional reset.

Finite sample timing, processing lag and captured navigation can cause a
coupled-chain miss even with a correct static radiometric equation. Source
extent/temperature, atmosphere, receiver FOV and gimbal/track dynamics must be
examined at their actual epochs before assigning a cause to a miss.

## Applicability, assumptions and equipment uncertainty

All 24 current cards select available mechanisms. That says nothing about an
OEM acquisition envelope. All full resolved values, units, original basis,
source IDs, notes and nonzero engineering uncertainties are retained in the
companion artifact; game-reference values remain game references. Common
mechanism code permits an equation-level equivalence cohort only with separate
native outputs for each model's parameters. It does not permit representative
equipment calibration or a substituted provider.

Aspect and range must be read for the exact variant. In particular, Magic2 must
not inherit Magic1's rear-sector restriction. The primary COMAERO account
[Missiles tactiques, printed page147](https://www.irsem.fr/storage/file_manager_files/2025/03/missiles-tactiques-comaero.pdf)
describes Magic2 frontal detection at least4.5km and a separate TRT electromagnetic
proximity fuze. This historical statement does not guarantee a5km kill against
the present target, altitude, thermal scene or missile state. R-60M must not
inherit original R-60 limits, or silently inherit R-60MK equipment parameters.
The [Polish Air Force R-60MK technical manual, Lot2821/89,1990](https://djvu.online/file/fUvs0bhsAlgza)
is a primary MK reference, not proof of an exact M head-on envelope. Its separate
thermal head and radar-fuze sections establish that MK has distinct functions;
they do not authorize a new M seeker model. Current M aspect/range coefficients
remain their disclosed engineering assumptions. An all-aspect label neither
guarantees head-on acquisition at every range nor excuses an observed miss.

The program's unchanged5km head-on and3km tail-turn population scenes have
different physical conditions. Both must retain their actual outcomes. A method
pass, availability label or aspect label cannot turn a native miss into a hit.

Known model limits include grey-body and effective-wavelength approximations,
rectangular projected supports, finite exposure sampling and frozen short-time
scene motion; reduced clutter/scintillation and waveform-equivalent processing;
assumed PSF, detector noise, target heat and atmosphere; and no admitted OEM
Pd/Pfa/ECCM calibration. Numerical tolerances below are not confidence intervals
for these physical uncertainties.

## Executed method comparison and reproduction

The historical authoring-time native fixture
`test_component_effect_reference_native.cpp` creates every original selected
provider, resolves its original physical policy and captures production methods.
It does not replace a descriptor with a scalar alias. For thermal cards it
captures band radiance at300/600/1000/2000 K, including MICA's second band, and a
uniform-scene detector charge through `ThermalImageReceiverV1::expose`. The charge
comparison verifies the actual imaging/quadrant policy's solid-angle, photon,
dark-current and temporal response path, before random noise/ADC. For RF cards
it captures both monostatic and bistatic production energy evaluations with
authored receiver parameters and actual native antenna gain. The separately
declared transmitter1000 W/linear gain100 and5/10km geometry are numerical
reference inputs, not an invented operational launcher fit.

`component_references_effects.py` uses55-digit Decimal analytic exponential-series
integration instead of native Simpson quadrature, factored link flux/aperture
instead of the collapsed radar expression, and independent photon-budget
evaluation. Predeclared relative budgets are1e-6 for Planck,1e-9 for charge and
2e-12 for radar energy, plus1e-12 absolute. The reference series has an explicit
positive geometric tail bound below1e-42. Independent wavelength-space numerical
quadrature, band additivity, grey scaling, link range/dwell/loss scalings and
failed/stale/foreign evidence controls exercise the checker itself.

The exact executed native and independent residuals, source hashes and passing
native report are in [seeker.json](seeker.json) and
[effects-results.v1.json](references/effects-results.v1.json). Until those actual
captures are admitted, their status remains incomplete. Source reference hashes
and scope are in [effects-primary-sources.json](references/effects-primary-sources.json).
The checker requires a pre-execution current input epoch and a nonzero passing,
non-skipped native report. Installed/public behavior and visual/full-chain gates
are separate evidence; this document is no substitute for them.

The historical pre-reticle Release capture passed the actual native Catch case with818
assertions. The independent comparison historically admitted all24 seeker rows across all
four mechanisms and88 numerical constraints, with the original budgets. The
shared input epoch and actual case-level JUnit are bound in `seeker.json`.
The whole four-entry CTest JUnit was retained separately; it was not rewritten
into a case report to satisfy admission. All72 effects-family rows historically passed
the historical matrix's144 separate theory/method gate validations. This records
the method scope above; the other matrix gates retain their own requirements.

## Exact current model differences

The seven nonimaging selections are `thermal_conscan_reticle.v1`, not the compatibility quadrant receiver. Their current native13-case first run had6 passes and7 fixture failures involving five nonunit test rays; normalized-ray rerun is pending. The actual new AIM-9M encounter still missed (CPA123.6438687m, age5.1667s; only4/1201 tracking rows, after age19.8s). None of that is promoted to a method or model pass here.

The reticle mask is applied before photon sampling: q=u+r(cos(phi),sin(phi)), T=1[|q|<=R]1[cos(n atan2(q))>=0]. Numerical optical cells feed ONE scalar detector; they are not imaging readout pixels. Complete phase-zero cycles, midpoint own-pose capture, pole state, measured-only waveform nuisance fitting and Fisher conditioning determine observability. Two resolved bearings are needed for a measured rate. Current inferred design uses R=min(W,H)*pitch/2, r=R/2, n=floor(pi*r/(8*sigma))=12 and f=1/(2*pi*n*tau)=132.629119Hz, with128 phases and4×4 spatial quadrature. The SA14 paper100Hz/1200Hz constants are not AAM data. See [the complete reticle method](../thermal-reticle-method.md).

not a claim about a run completing later.

common band-integrated radiance does not by itself verify spectral association.

# Fuze method, initiation lifecycle and primary geometry reference

Current-status update, 2026-11-03: the JSON now documents each current model
individually in theory, parameter and fidelity matrices. Its current `passed`
flag is false until a fresh actual native comparison under these source/card
hashes succeeds. Earlier72-row/836-constraint and older818-assertion results
are historical only and remain nested as `historical_evidence`. They do not
verify the new reticle receiver or the current scene-policy epoch. The separate
[72-cell parameterized table](per-model-effects-components.json) retains exact
source records and does not grant native/public/visual or calibration status.


The companion [fuze.json](fuze.json) binds all24 AAMs individually to their
original selector, native mechanism and complete resolved parameter/source
records. There are two current mechanism cohorts, retained swept-path legacy
and turning CPA. The model is a declared reduced-order geometric initiation
model; it is not a simulated OEM RF/optical TDD circuit. A passing method row
does not establish a coupled detonation or target damage.

## Geometry, state and discretization

For captured relative endpoints `r0=own0-target0` and `r1=own1-target1`, let
`d=r1-r0`. A nonstationary segment has an unconstrained minimum at

\[
u_*=-\frac{r_0\cdot d}{d\cdot d},\quad
r(u)=r_0+ud,\quad d_{CPA}=\|r(u_*)\|.
\]

The independent reference is [David Eberly's Geometric Tools point/segment
distance query](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/davideberly/GeometricTools/master/GTE/Mathematics/DistPointSegment.h),
file version8.0.2025.05.10, operator lines42-85. It handles non-unit segments,
clamped endpoints and stationary segments. Our checker computes the projection
with exact `Fraction` endpoints and evaluates the final square root independently.
This source establishes distance geometry, not a fuze, arming or target-detection
law. The original file is Boost Software License1.0; no source is vendored or
executed by this checker. The downloaded bytes and their scope are recorded in
the primary-source manifest.

The actual SDK merges native captured own/target path knots and evaluates each
piecewise-linear relative segment. It does not propagate a target into a future
window. Fractions refer to the original captured decision window. The armed,
live interval is `[armingS,lifeS)`; arming is inclusive and expiry exclusive.
Malformed/nonfinite geometry, missing captured coverage and illegal model
combinations are refused, preserving unknown diagnostics.

Legacy V0 takes the constrained minimum on the active interval, including
eligible endpoints. Turning V1 initiates only at an actual stationary point or
a closing-to-opening path corner in the active interval. A clamped approach
endpoint inside the radius is not a V1 turn. Stationary relative overlap alone
also supplies no V1 turn. Its cross-decision state stores the previous exact
boundary pose/time, relative movement and generation/target identity. Gaps,
target changes and noncontiguous captured paths invalidate that history; a
history reset is not a new release or a rearming command.

The delayed-initiation state is separate: Fresh -> Pending -> Sealed. Scheduling
captures the authoritative trigger launch age, fixed target ID and declared
delay. Due is authorized only in the containing or exactly contiguous live
captured window. A cutoff/contact/expiry cancels pending initiation rather than
inventing future pose. Delay configuration changes and time gaps refuse. A
completed/cancelled release cannot schedule again; only a new release resets it.

Physical contact is a separate selected native path. Authored point/structure
contact uses validated closed triangles, captured contact geometry and exact
finite segment/triangle tests, including coplanar contact. A broadphase box or
artificial ownership cap alone does not authorize contact. World chooses the
earliest actual contact, proximity/delay or terrain terminal event with its
native ordering and one-shot lifecycle; the reference checker grants none of
those authorities.

## Input/output boundary and independent target detection

Inputs to the pure adapter are selected timing/radius/station/body parameters,
captured own/target paths, current target identity and live cutoff. Outputs are
validity, actual fraction, miss distance and trigger, or delayed due/pending
status. No main-seeker tracking bit is an input to either geometry method.

Current World orchestration must be distinguished from this pure contract.
V1 scans its explicitly assumed ideal physical sphere independently of main-
seeker tracking. The23 current V0 AAM cards now explicitly select the additive
binding `target_detection_v1="native.time_armed_geometric_scene.v1"`. This
assumed geometric detector also scans captured physical aircraft, debris and
finite decoys independently of the main seeker, using each card's unchanged
V0 constrained-minimum sweep, arming, lifetime and radius. No additional delay
or V1 turn law is introduced. Candidate choice is earliest fraction, then stable
native identity; none of this scene data is fed into guidance. Inert jettison
does not arm that field. V1 station/history and initiation remain unchanged.

Absent-policy V0 profiles retain their original tracking-gated, held-target
dispatch and original provider behavior. Unknown policy names/values are
refused; this particular optional binding is admitted only on V0 mechanisms.
No provider ID, public interface, layout, numeric parameter or native outcome
meaning is changed. The declaration is a new explicit simulator assumption,
not a newly discovered RF/laser OEM law.

The retained original AIM120D5km head-on counterexample had actual armed CPA
1.1723276214934657m at launch age5.421845701496136s, within the original
11.47213595499958m radius, with no main track at either captured endpoint and
no proximity detonation. All1201 original kinematic trace rows were unchanged
by the diagnostic observation. This establishes the missing dispatch seam;
it does not attribute unrelated misses such as the retained165m AIM9M case to
the same cause. The original full-chain scene remains the repair regression.

Primary technical literature supports several sensor architectures, not one
universal OEM behavior. [US8033221B2](https://patents.google.com/patent/US8033221B2/en)
describes sharing SAL optics while distinguishing guidance and additional
proximity returns. [US9709372B2](https://patents.google.com/patent/US9709372B2/en)
describes a separate semi-active RF proximity embodiment with multiple antenna
channels and angle/rate processing. Neither patent assigns that hardware to all
24 cards. COMAERO's primary [Missiles tactiques, printed pp147-148](https://www.irsem.fr/storage/file_manager_files/2025/03/missiles-tactiques-comaero.pdf)
specifically distinguishes Magic2's TRT electromagnetic proximity fuze and
AIM9L's active laser fuze. The [Polish Air Force R-60MK manual, sections3.3-3.5](https://djvu.online/file/fUvs0bhsAlgza)
separates radar proximity, contact and safe/arming functions from thermal
homing. MK facts are not silently transferred to our M card.

Consequently, the current ideal radius law remains an engineering assumption.
No numerical radius, delay, look angle, TDD sensitivity or safe-arm timing is
promoted from a general patent to an OEM parameter. Every per-model card basis
and uncertainty remains visible. A main-seeker dropout followed by no detonation
requires actual captured minimum range/live/arming evidence before attribution;
it must not be repaired by relabeling a miss as a hit.

## Numerical comparisons, limits and failure modes

The actual selected provider is instantiated for every AAM. Two identical
captured crossing geometries have transverse miss0.5 and1.5 times the **actual
resolved** radius. Their independent projected fraction is0.5; the first is
inside and the second outside. A third approach-only case ends inside the
radius without an actual turn and distinguishes the two method cohorts. The
fixture retains the actual model version, arming/lifetime/delay and original
card hash. It does not swap a V0 card to V1, alter its radius, or force detonation.

The comparison budget is64 binary64 eps relative plus1e-12 absolute for distance
and fraction; discrete decisions have zero tolerance. Exact-rational stationary,
endpoint and adjacent-representable controls exercise the reference. Malformed
JSON, foreign/duplicate/missing populations, changed reference geometry,
stale epochs and failed/skipped native reports are refused. Timing/one-shot,
terrain, contact, body-station and actual World lifecycle have separate native
tests; the common projection pass is not their complete acceptance.

Known limits include linear interpolation between captured knots, an ideal
spherical detection field instead of RF/laser physics, model-specific retained
legacy endpoint behavior, frozen short-time geometry and assumed source
parameters. Numerical verification does not calibrate real safe-arm distance,
TDD jamming resistance, target discrimination, delay electronics or fuze
probability of functioning. These limitations cannot justify missing executable
functionality; they define the evidence needed for the corresponding claim.

Historical residuals, complete24 rows and hash-bound raw reports are in
[fuze.json](fuze.json) and [effects-results.v1.json](references/effects-results.v1.json).
Before a passing actual capture, these products remain incomplete. Native,
installed/public, coupled-chain and visual evidence are joined separately.

The pre-policy Release actual native case passed818 assertions for the full
effects observation fixture. Its independent fuze comparison historically admitted all24
original selected providers, both fuze mechanisms and192 numerical constraints,
with no changed radius, arming time, captured geometry or tolerance. The original
four-entry CTest JUnit and a fresh actual case-level Catch JUnit are both retained;
the checker consumed the latter. That exact source/card epoch is retained in
the policy-window snapshots; current-policy proof requires fresh capture and
source binding. These results establish the stated geometry
and cohort distinctions, not a guarantee that World dispatches every physical
encounter to a fuze or that an entire engagement detonates.

## Parameter equality is a disclosed modeling gap

When complete numeric policy and selected mechanism/receiver coincide, the
JSON lists `identical_numeric_policy_models` explicitly. This is reused
engineering parameterization, not proof of identical hardware or separate
per-model tuning. Every model still needs its own actual capture. Different
equipment selection IDs, source notes and metadata hashes alone do not supply
different physical response, OEM internal construction, or calibration.

state_io_discretization.states: One emitted field, stable source ordinals, material age, point/rod endpoint positions and velocities, connected-unfolding age until breakup, per-victim crossing history.
state_io_discretization.inputs: This exact card charge/case/Gurney data, captured burst pose/velocity/spin and RNG; native moving target geometry/material/environment.
state_io_discretization.outputs: Finite point/rod population, remaining energy/momentum, skin/component work and source-attributed native damage; no hit probability scalar.
state_io_discretization.discretization: Integer equivalent fragment count; rigid captured source transform; native chronological material crossings and continuation. Angular zones overlap where authored. Spatial/temporal convergence is separate from parameter calibration.

warhead.full_family_text:
# Warhead source, material effects and primary numerical references

Current-status update, 2026-11-03: the JSON now documents each current model
individually in theory, parameter and fidelity matrices. Its current `passed`
flag is false until a fresh actual native comparison under these source/card
hashes succeeds. Earlier72-row/836-constraint and older818-assertion results
are historical only and remain nested as `historical_evidence`. They do not
verify the new reticle receiver or the current scene-policy epoch. The separate
[72-cell parameterized table](per-model-effects-components.json) retains exact
source records and does not grant native/public/visual or calibration status.


The 24 AAM selectors resolve to three actual source mechanisms: zoned case,
finite zoned case V2 and connected-ring rod. The companion
[warhead.json](warhead.json) preserves each model's full parameter provenance,
uncertainty, selected implementation and mechanism delta. The common source
methods do not identify OEM explosive/case construction or establish calibrated
lethality. The two additional explosive cards are covered by the separate
26-card effects population; they are not invented AAM component rows here.

## Charge-to-source equations and assumptions

The primary basis is [R.W.Gurney, BRL Report405 (1943), equations2.1,2.3,2.4,
printed pp4-5](https://www.pdf-archive.com/2019/11/16/untitled-pdf-document/untitled-pdf-document.pdf),
an archived reproduction of the public-release report. Its uniform cylindrical
case assumes gas radial velocity increases linearly from zero on the axis to
case velocity. With case mass M, charge mass C and explosive specific energy E,

\[
EC=(M/2+C/4)v^2,\qquad
v=\frac{\sqrt{2E}}{\sqrt{M/C+1/2}}.
\]

The actual `gurney_ms` input is sqrt(2E). It is not TNT equivalence. The SDK
derives or explicitly resolves case mass and finite envelope according to the
selected source version. Current parameter source records retain whether case
geometry, charge or energetic properties are published, derived, assumed or
game references. The original report's uniform cylinder theory is not evidence
for our finite station, angular zones, case breakup, rod welds or any OEM
explosive constant.

For point fragments, the emitted population conserves case mass with equal
equivalent masses `M/N`; speed relative to the unrotating source is v. Its kinetic
energy is `Mv²/2`. Finite V2 resolves the authored annular case, station, axial
length and angular zones. Legacy zoned cards retain their established derived
case envelope and angular law. Zone sampling is uniform in cosine over the
chosen solid-angle band, with the declared zone shares; it is not a uniform
angle approximation. The War Thunder seven-zone reference remains a game
reference, not a fragment-arena measurement. Discrete rods span their full
equivalent finite length. Legacy rod speed retains its established1400m/s cap;
this explicit delta is compared rather than quietly removed.

The connected-ring selection is explicit, never inferred from the word `rod`.
N homogeneous line elements share adjacent polygon endpoints and endpoint
velocities. The initial radius is outer-case radius r; expansion rate is v/r.
Maximum radius is `N*length/(2*pi)`, so breakup age is
`(Rmax-r)/v`. Material length is the actual final chord, not a false assertion
that polygon chord and arc lengths are equal. Thereafter each element is a
finite independently flying rod. This is a homogenized source approximation,
not a claim that N is an OEM weld count.

The kinetic energy of an affine-velocity rod is evaluated by the exact line
integral

\[
K_i=\frac{m_i}{6}(v_{0i}\cdot v_{0i}+v_{0i}\cdot v_{1i}+v_{1i}\cdot v_{1i}).
\]

For an unrotating regular connected ring this gives
`K=(Mv²/2)*(2+cos(2*pi/N))/3`. Treating every segment as a point at an endpoint
would give the wrong energy. Total linear momentum integrates the two endpoints
with equal weights. Rigid-body source translation and spin are added using the
captured station/lever arm in the native path, preserving frame conventions.

## Material interaction, state, input/output and time

World owns one immutable emitted population for a physical burst, not a new
fragment draw per victim. Stable source ordinals and per-face/per-victim crossing
state survive continuation. Inputs are the resolved source, captured burst
pose/velocity/axis/angular velocity, RNG, attached native geometry/material,
captured recipient motion and finite environment. Outputs are emitted and
remaining populations, source identities, component/panel hits, perforation and
hole areas, transferred/retained/air/gravity momentum and body linear/angular
impulses. Source RNG consumption is transactional on refusal.

The causal scene assessor orders actual crossings across recipients, retains
residual fragments, and handles finite rods as segments rather than endpoint
rays. THOR aluminium2024-T3 residual velocity is an empirical steel-fragment
plate law with its original unit conversions and obliquity policy. It is not
universal composite/titanium/uranium penetration physics. Solid component
interception and finite-fluid transit have distinct native methods. Liquid
geometry/density/ownership and unresolved tumbling Cd have separate declared
assumptions and numerical gates; no wet component is counted as a perfect solid
absorber or as calibrated fuel ballistics.

Blast uses the declared TNT-equivalent input and the retained Swisdak/Kingery-
Bulmash fit, Sachs ambient scaling, facing/reflection and panel impulse law.
The implementation uses a hemispherical fit at half TNT mass as its declared
free-air engineering approximation. Empirical scaled-range clamps and ideal-gas
reflection are limits, not arbitrary far-field or obstacle/shielding fidelity.
The primary source is [Swisdak, Simplified Kingery Airblast Calculations,
1994, ADA526744](https://ntrl.ntis.gov/NTRL/dashboard/searchResults/titleDetail/ADA526744.xhtml).
This package's independent numerical comparison below targets charge/source
conservation, not an independent remeasurement of those blast/THOR fits. Their
equation domains and the current native effects regressions remain separately
required.

Scene point flight has one material-phase scheduler; fixed-phase smooth
integration resolves actual captured moving material-boundary roots. Finite
absolute clock progress, local-coordinate arithmetic and earliest real-work
timestamps are native contracts. Rod loads integrate affine material velocity
over owned intervals with global error budgets and exact shared-face ownership;
no double loading on adjacent cell faces. Continuation keeps physical age and
live material content; it does not expose future intersections. Scene angular
impulses are about each instantaneous moving structural origin in the initial
body axes; the World consumer must not add the legacy fixed-origin translation.
Legacy synchronous/external assessment keeps its own original convention.

## Independent numerical comparison and cohort-specific proof

The actual selected `WarheadAdapter` and additive scene capability are used for
each authored AAM. The fixture captures resolved Gurney/case/charge parameters,
native cylinder speed and source speed, then emits the real selected source at
fixed seed1943, zero translation/spin and axis(1,0,0). These conditions isolate
source conservation; they do not suppress any production coefficient or select
a substitute provider. All three mechanism cohorts have actual per-model
observations rather than one representative row.

The checker solves the primary energy balance independently with55-digit
Decimal arithmetic. It checks actual point/rod population count, emitted total
mass, energy, minimum/maximum speed, finite radial/axial envelope and segment
type. The connected cohort additionally checks exact adjacent endpoint closure,
zero net momentum within accumulated arithmetic budget, expansion rate, breakup
age and both material-chord extremes. These are additional geometric and
conservation derivations, explicitly our source-method controls rather than
measurements attributed to the Gurney paper.

Predeclared numerical budgets are2e-12 relative plus1e-12 absolute for Gurney;
1e-10 relative plus1e-6 J for population energy; mass accumulation64 eps*N;
and128 eps times source size for envelope arithmetic. Count, segment identity
and ring endpoint closure have zero tolerance. No tolerance was fitted to a
coupled hit, radius, lethality or card. Negative tests corrupt mass, energy,
population, finite envelope and topology and require refusal. Exact actual
inputs/outputs/differences are in [warhead.json](warhead.json) and
[effects-results.v1.json](references/effects-results.v1.json).

The original 26-card native effects population separately requires actual scene
emission, assessment and native damage, including fragment fuel holes rather
than blast-only destruction. Moving-origin, continuation, shared-face and
finite-clock/kernel regressions remain separate. A source-method comparison
does not replace those tests, per-component functional damage, installed public
execution, whole-chain fuze/pose transport or full visual evidence.

## Known fidelity limits

Unknown internal case geometry and energetic/fragment distributions remain
explicit assumptions with full per-model records. Uniform equivalent fragments,
homogenized rods, fixed angular laws, finite pose discretization, empirical
plate/blast laws, perfect solid-component absorption, unresolved fluid tumbling,
fire initiation and structural response are not a validated high-explosive
hydrocode or OEM vulnerability model. The source method has executable effects
and conservation checks; claiming aircraft-specific kill probability or greater
fidelity than another simulator would require distinct held-out measurements.

The historical pre-reticle Release actual native case passed818 assertions for the effects
observation fixture. Independent warhead comparisons historically admitted all24 selected
sources across all three mechanisms and292 numerical constraints, including
connected-ring energy/endpoint/length checks, without changing any original
budget or coefficient. Actual capture, pre-execution source epoch, case-level
JUnit and residuals are hash-bound in `warhead.json`. This source-method result
does not replace the separate original26 population's functional damage,
material integration, whole-chain or installed/visual requirements.

## Actual material-law parameterization

For every row, current World scene emission uses `m_scene=M/N`; the retained
synchronous legacy assessor uses its pre-round nominal `fragmentKg`. These are
separate entry points. The scene emitter draws starts inside a finite inferred
shell even for V0: axial position in `[-L/2,L/2]`, azimuth uniform, and radius
squared uniform between `max(0,ro-t)^2` and `ro^2`. V2 instead uses its exact
annulus. Legacy synchronous V0 assessment retains its point-source angular law.
Discrete rod segments span the complete equivalent length parallel to the burst
axis; only the explicit connected selection shares polygon endpoints. Its
retained 85–95 degree zone record does not drive the connected-ring emitter.

The current THOR implementation, for plate thickness h in inches, presented area
A in square inches, fragment mass m in grains and speed v in ft/s, is
`v_out=max(v-10^7.047*(h*A)^1.029*m^-1.072*sec(theta)^1.251*v^-0.139,0)`.
The SDK clips angle magnitude to1.45rad and cos(theta) below by0.12, then converts
the result to m/s. Each model's JSON row carries its own fragment mass and area
in this same law. Those angular guards are numerical policy, not a calibrated
near-grazing validity extension. The original TR47 experimental domain has not
been independently re-established in this documentation pass; the coefficients
are accurately identified as the existing steel/2024-T3 empirical code, not a
newly verified universal material table. DU rods, composite delamination and
actual case material substitutions require distinct evidence.

The blast implementation evaluates `exp(sum(c_i*ln(Z)^i))`, using
`Z=R/(0.5*W_TNT)^(1/3)*(p_ambient/101325)^(1/3)`. Pressure scales with ambient
pressure; positive-phase impulse also scales with charge^(1/3), pressure^(2/3)
and sqrt(288.15/T). Scaled-range pressure clamps are0.2–198.5 and impulse clamps
0.2–158.7. Its ideal reflection formula is
`2*Ps*(7*Pa+4*Ps)/(7*Pa+Ps)`. [The NTIS Swisdak record](https://ntrl.ntis.gov/NTRL/dashboard/searchResults/titleDetail/ADA526744.xhtml)
identifies a simplified hemispherical surface-burst fit; the half-charge
free-air mapping is the SDK's explicit approximation, not a result supplied by
that reference. No fragment arena, plate campaign or blast measurement is
created by evaluating these equations.

## Parameter equality is a disclosed modeling gap

When complete numeric policy and selected mechanism/receiver coincide, the
JSON lists `identical_numeric_policy_models` explicitly. This is reused
engineering parameterization, not proof of identical hardware or separate
per-model tuning. Every model still needs its own actual capture. Different
equipment selection IDs, source notes and metadata hashes alone do not supply
different physical response, OEM internal construction, or calibration.

Sensitivity coefficients in the JSON are for the uncapped Gurney cylinder
speed. All seven current rod-source selections reach the retained1400m/s cap.
Their local source-speed derivatives with respect to case mass, charge and
Gurney constant are zero only inside that capped branch; the boundary is
nonsmooth. The cap does not remove uncertainty in fragment mass, count, geometry,
coverage or penetration. R-77M, like R-60M and R-73, selects discrete rods under
zoned_case.v1; only the four R-27 selections instantiate connected rings.

<rocket_engine name="meteor atmosphere-fed engineering sustainer">
    <isp>
        <function>
            <quotient>
                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/gross-thrust-n</property>
                <max>
                    <value>9.9999999999999998e-13</value>
                    <product>
                        <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/fuel-kg-s</property>
                        <value>9.8066499999999994</value>
                    </product>
                </max>
            </quotient>
        </function>
    </isp>
    <propflowmax unit="LBS/SEC">0.66138678655463268</propflowmax>
    <mixtureratio>0</mixtureratio>
    <minthrottle>0.000001</minthrottle>
    <property value="0">fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-kg-s</property>
    <property value="0">fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-enthalpy-w</property>
    <property value="0">fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-momentum-x-n</property>
    <property value="0">fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-momentum-y-n</property>
    <property value="0">fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-momentum-z-n</property>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/fuel-kg-s" type="pre">
        <product>
            <property>propulsion/engine[1]/fuel-flow-rate-pps</property>
            <value>0.45359237000000002</value>
        </product>
    </function>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/burned-fuel-kg-s" type="pre">
        <min>
            <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/fuel-kg-s</property>
            <product>
                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-kg-s</property>
                <value>0.080000000000000002</value>
            </product>
        </min>
    </function>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/total-temperature-k" type="pre">
        <quotient>
            <sum>
                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-enthalpy-w</property>
                <product>
                    <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/burned-fuel-kg-s</property>
                    <value>36000000</value>
                </product>
            </sum>
            <max>
                <value>9.9999999999999998e-13</value>
                <product>
                    <sum>
                        <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-kg-s</property>
                        <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/fuel-kg-s</property>
                    </sum>
                    <value>1150</value>
                </product>
            </max>
        </quotient>
    </function>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/pressure-ratio" type="pre">
        <max>
            <value>1</value>
            <product>
                <value>0.84999999999999998</value>
                <pow>
                    <quotient>
                        <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-enthalpy-w</property>
                        <max>
                            <value>9.9999999999999998e-13</value>
                            <product>
                                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-kg-s</property>
                                <value>558.05555555555554</value>
                                <property>atmosphere/T-R</property>
                            </product>
                        </max>
                    </quotient>
                    <value>3.5</value>
                </pow>
            </product>
        </max>
    </function>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/exit-speed-m-s" type="pre">
        <sqrt>
            <max>
                <value>0</value>
                <product>
                    <value>2300</value>
                    <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/total-temperature-k</property>
                    <difference>
                        <value>1</value>
                        <pow>
                            <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/pressure-ratio</property>
                            <value>-0.24812030075187974</value>
                        </pow>
                    </difference>
                </product>
            </max>
        </sqrt>
    </function>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/gross-thrust-n" type="pre">
        <product>
            <sum>
                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-kg-s</property>
                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/fuel-kg-s</property>
            </sum>
            <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/exit-speed-m-s</property>
        </product>
    </function>
</rocket_engine>

theory.equations: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. ARH uses its own transmitter and finite terminal eclipse/measurement lifecycle.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
